definitions.explanation: Preliminary cooking tasks like washing, cutting, and pre-cooking ingredients.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}の{下|した}ごしらえをする。
{下|した}ごしらえを{済|す}ませておく。
examples.english: To finish the prep work in advance.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}の{下|した}ごしらえが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Preparing the meat properly is important.

notes:
{下|した}ごしらえ refers to the preliminary preparation done before actual cooking begins.

WORD FORMATION:
{下|した} (under, preliminary) + ごしらえ (from {拵|こしら}える, to prepare)

COMMON TASKS:
- {野菜|やさい}を{洗|あら}う・{切|き}る: washing and cutting vegetables
- {肉|にく}に{下味|したあじ}をつける: seasoning meat
- {野菜|やさい}を{茹|ゆ}でる: blanching vegetables
- {灰汁|あく}{抜|ぬ}き: removing bitterness

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {下|した}ごしらえをする: to do prep work
- {下|した}ごしらえを{済|す}ませる: to finish prep work

RELATED WORDS:
- {下味|したあじ}: preliminary seasoning
- {仕込|しこ}み: preparation (often for restaurants)
